content: Spring AMQP CorrelationData.getFuture() returns CompletableFuture<Confirm> (ack/nack + reason); getReturned() populated before future completes when publisher-returns + mandatory enabled; correlation id must be unique. Only one ConfirmCallback per RabbitTemplate; prefer per-send CorrelationData future. Requires spring.rabbitmq.publisher-confirm-type=correlated. RabbitTemplate.receive uses basicGet with autoAck when channel not transacted (message removed on delivery) - use execute(ChannelCallback) with basicGet(autoAck=false) for safe DLQ drain.
